title: Bartlesville, Oklahoma
method: Unseen ordinary commercial street · separate image seasons
seen: The revised terrain reveals the lower shops and the laser survey restores the raised entrance roof. The default shop still wears generic brick and windows. The field photograph shows pale masonry, individual shop doors, parked cars and a freestanding sign.
measurement: Across 75 columns at 960 × 720, median roofline error fell from 22 to 3 pixels and the 90th percentile fell from 28.6 to 5. Ground elevation errors on 702 withheld federal laser returns fell from 2.35 to 0.04 m median. The February photographer position was registered with separate surveyed controls.
author: Panoramax · Baloo Uriza · February 12, 2026 · CC BY-SA 4.0
